items.headline: Abu Dhabi me Ukraine shaanti vaarta shuru
items.detail: Russia, Ukraine aur America ke beech do din ki teen-pakshiya vaarta Abu Dhabi me shuru hui — February ke baad pehli baar; suraksha guarantee aur yuddh-viraam par baat hogi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh aur shaanti vaarta — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Gaza me baadh, hazaaron tent doobe
items.detail: Gaza me bhaari baarish se hazaaron tent doob gaye aur paanch logon ki maut hui; Board of Peace ne Israel se sardiyon ki sahayata turant dene ko kaha.
items.exam_angle: Gaza manaviya sankat aur Board of Peace — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Krakow hamle ka hamlaavaran hospital me mara
items.detail: Krakow ke Main Market Square me golibaari karne wala 24 saal ka hamlaavaran hospital me mar gaya; hamle me chhah log mare gaye jinme ek British nagrik bhi hai, 16 ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Poland me 1989 ke baad sabse bada samuhik hamla — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: China ka trade surplus $1.04 trillion paar
items.detail: China ka vyaapaar adhishesh January-October me $1.04 trillion raha — doosre saal $1 trillion paar, pichhle saal se ek mahina pehle; October me niryat 35.2% badha, AI upkaran ki maang ne badhat di.
items.exam_angle: China ki arthvyavastha aur vaishvik vyaapaar — arthvyavastha aur antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Damascus me Macron ke hotel ke paas do dhamake
items.detail: Syria yatra ke dusre din Damascus me Four Seasons Hotel ke paas do visfot hue, 18 log ghayal hue jinme chaar policekarmi hain; Macron surakshit hain aur unki yatra jaari rahegi.
items.exam_angle: Assad ke baad Syria me pehli badi pashchimi yatra — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Riyadh ki taraf do Houthi missile giraye
items.detail: Saudi netritva wale gathbandhan ne Riyadh ki taraf daage gaye ek ballistic aur ek cruise missile ko rok kar nasht kar diya; dakshin kshetra ki taraf daaga ek aur missile bhi giraya gaya, koi nuksaan ki khabar nahi.
items.exam_angle: Houthi-Saudi tanav aur Hormuz — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Houthi hamle me Riyadh ki Aramco imarat ko nuksaan
items.detail: Yemen ke Houthi samuh ke hamle me Riyadh ki Aramco prashasanik imarat ko seemit nuksaan pahuncha, koi hatahat nahi; Houthi ne zimmedari li, aur Madina me East-West tel pipeline par bhi hamla hua, aag bujha di gayi.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz aur Paschimi Asia me tanaav — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Nvidia aarop: America me chip kanoon sakht hoga
items.detail: Nvidia ke CEO Jensen Huang ke ek sandehspad Chinese agent se sambandh ki khabar ke baad America ki Congress chip niryat par sakht kanoon lane ki taraf badh rahi hai; China ne aarop ko 'smear campaign' kaha hai.
items.exam_angle: America-China chip yuddh aur takniki pratibandh — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump: Iran se jang 'practically khatm'
items.detail: Qatar ke pradhanmantri se mulaqaat ke baad Trump ne kaha Iran sainya roop se 'effectively over' hai aur hamle dobara shuru hona 'quite unlikely' hai; nausainik nakabandi aur Operation Iron Gate jaari rahenge.
items.exam_angle: Iran yuddh aur Paschimi Asia ki sthiti — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Pope ne Argentina me peediton se mulaqaat ki
items.detail: Pope Leo XIV ne Buenos Aires me paanch pujari-durvyavahar peediton se ek ghante se zyada baat ki; Vatican ne kaha — suraksha upaay mazboot karne ka vaada, yatra me aisi aur mulaqaatein hongi.
items.exam_angle: Pope ki Latin America yatra aur Vatican ki suraksha neeti — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Russia-Ukraine: Zameen par narmi ke sanket
items.detail: Abu Dhabi me aaj se shuru ho rahi America ki madhyasthata wali vaarta se pehle ek americi adhikari ne kaha — dono paksh niji taur par zameen ki adla-badli par lacheele hain; Ukraine ke liye suraksha guarantee bhi agenda me hai.
items.exam_angle: Abu Dhabi vaarta aur Ukraine yuddh — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Pope ki Buenos Aires sabha me 25 lakh
items.detail: Pope Leo XIV ki Buenos Aires me khuli sabha me Vatican ke mutabik 25 lakh log jute — 1987 ke baad Argentina ki pehli papal yatra me unke karyakal ki sabse badi bheed; Pope ne samaj ke sabse kamzor varg ki suraksha ki appeal ki.
items.exam_angle: Pope ki Latin America yatra aur Vatican ki bhoomika — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Gobierno de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires (CC BY 2.5 ar)

items.headline: France: Iran ne supermarket fridge hack kiye
items.detail: France ne kaha October me 700 supermarkets ke fridge hack karne ke peeche Iran ke IRGC se judi Shahid Kaveh unit thi; Iran ke raajdoot ko bulaya gaya aur EU pratibandh ki maang ki gayi.
items.exam_angle: Cyber hamla aur Iran-France tanav — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Syria: Yemen me sena bhejne ki yojana nahi
items.detail: Syria ke videsh mantri Asaad al-Shaibani ne kaha Yemen me Syria ki koi sena nahi hai aur nikat bhavishya me bhejne ki yojana bhi nahi; Saudi Arabia ke saath raksha samjhauta sena punarnirman aur prashikshan tak seemit hai.
items.exam_angle: Paschimi Asia aur Saudi-Syria raksha samjhauta — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump ne midterm nateejon par sawal uthaye
items.detail: Trump ne Truth Social par bina saboot ke midterm chunav me dhokhadhadi ka aarop lagaya; pehle unhone nateeje sweekar karne ki baat kahi thi.
items.exam_angle: America me chunav aur loktantra par bahas — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Russell Brand ko 10.5 saal ki jail
items.detail: London ki adalat ne Brand ko ek balatkar aur teen yaun hamlo ka doshi paakar 10 saal 6 mahine ki saza sunayi; judge ne unhe 'sexual predator' kaha.

items.headline: China ne America par niyantran ki rok badhayi
items.detail: China ne 11 americi sansthaon par pratibandh aur 16 sansthaon ko dual-use vastuon ke niryat par rok do mahine aur badha di; 24% atirikt tariff par rok bhi aaj se do mahine badhegi.
items.exam_angle: China-America vyaapaar vaarta aur niryat niyantran — arthvyavastha aur antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Dakshin Africa: ANC ki sabse badi haar
items.detail: Sthaniya chunav me ANC ko sirf 31% vote mile — 1994 ke baad sabse kharab nateeja; DA 25% ke saath doosre sthan par; mahasachiv Mbalula ne ise 'catastrophic' kaha; ab gathbandhan ki baatchit hogi.
items.exam_angle: Dakshin Africa me loktantra aur gathbandhan rajneeti — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: COP31 Antalya me shuru, bijli par zor
items.detail: Turkiye ke Antalya me COP31 shuru hua — Turkiye mezban, Australia vaarta ka netritva karega; 2035 tak bijli ki hissedari 35% karne ka prastaav aur jalvayu vitt par zor.
items.exam_angle: COP31 aur Paris samjhauta — paryavaran aur antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Paraguay: Hataye gaye rashtrapati ke ghar chhapa
items.detail: Ueno Bank ke dhahne ke baad Senate ne shukravaar ko rashtrapati Santiago Peña ko pad se hataya; ravivaar ko police ne unke ghar par chhapa mara, unpar vishwasghat aur niji laabh ke aarop hain, aur ve sainya suvidha me hirasat me hain.
items.exam_angle: Bank sankat se rashtrapati ka patan — Latin America ki rajniti aur banking niyaman ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Office of the President, Taiwan (CC BY 4.0)

items.headline: Izmir: Steel plant me dhamaka, 10 ki maut
items.detail: HABAS steel plant me crane girne se furnace me visfot hua; 15 ghayal, 4 laapata, bachav kaam jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Audyogik durghatna aur suraksha manak — aapda prabandhan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Japan Philippines ko radar-drone dega
items.detail: Japan ne Philippines ko 4.3 arab yen ($27 million) ke tahat tateeya radar aur nigrani drone dene ka samjhauta kiya — OSA ke tahat pehli baar taiyaar raksha upkaran ka transfer.
items.exam_angle: Dakshin Cheen Sagar aur Japan-Philippines raksha sahyog — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Novaya Gazeta band, Moscow karyalaya khaali
items.detail: Russia ke swatantra akhbaar Novaya Gazeta ne aaj antim sampadakiya baithak ke baad apna Moscow karyalaya khaali kar diya — 'foreign agent' ka darja aur daan par rok ke baad kaam jaari rakhna namumkin hua; sansthapak Muratov ne abhivyakti ki swatantrata ki appeal ki.
items.exam_angle: Russia me media swatantrata aur press par dabav — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: IMF ki Ukraine sameeksha se $1.67bn milega
items.detail: IMF ne Ukraine ke $8.1bn karz karyakram ki doosri-teesri sameeksha shuru ki; manzoori par $1.67bn ki kisht milegi, jabki Ukraine ko agle saal $70bn ki kami ka saamna hai.
items.exam_angle: IMF aur Ukraine arthvyavastha — antarrashtriya vittiya sansthaon ke liye mahatvapurna.
